name: @sleepymug/fleet
description: fleet's gateway, the hub everything dials: it keeps boxes, containers each with fleet's helper in it, and their lifetime; takes in services, whose servers serve them over tunnels they open; and carries each call to where it goes, a box's to its helper, a service's to its server

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
